name: simplepractice-mcp
description: SimplePractice Client Portal for Claude — appointments, billing, documents, and announcements

simplepractice_practice.title: Client Portal address
simplepractice_practice.description: Your practice's Client Portal address — either the slug ("achievebalancetherapy") or the full host ("achievebalancetherapy.clientsecure.me"). It is the host in the portal link your provider emailed you.

simplepractice_session_file.title: Session file
simplepractice_session_file.description: Where to keep the signed-in session (default ~/.simplepractice-mcp/session.json, written 0600).

tools.name: simplepractice_session_status
tools.description: Report whether a Client Portal session is held, and for which practice.

tools.name: simplepractice_request_sign_in_link
tools.description: Ask SimplePractice to email a Client Portal sign-in link. Confirm-gated; rate-limited upstream.

tools.name: simplepractice_verify_sign_in_token
tools.description: Exchange an emailed sign-in link (or its token) for a Client Portal session.

tools.name: simplepractice_verify_sign_in_pin
tools.description: Exchange a 6-digit Client Portal sign-in PIN for a session.

tools.name: simplepractice_sign_out
tools.description: Discard the stored Client Portal session.

tools.name: simplepractice_get_account
tools.description: The practice, the current client, and every client this login can see.

tools.name: simplepractice_list_appointments
tools.description: Scheduled or requested appointments, with clinician and location.

tools.name: simplepractice_list_billing_items
tools.description: Invoices, statements, superbills, receipts, or account history.

tools.name: simplepractice_list_payment_methods
tools.description: Payment methods saved to the portal — brand, last four, expiry.

tools.name: simplepractice_list_document_requests
tools.description: Paperwork the practice has sent, with an outstanding-only filter.

tools.name: simplepractice_get_document_request
tools.description: One document request in full, with its body or questions and answers.

tools.name: simplepractice_list_documents
tools.description: Files the practice has shared through the portal.

tools.name: simplepractice_list_announcements
tools.description: Announcements the practice has posted, with unread counts.

tools.name: simplepractice_healthcheck
tools.description: Resolves the credential the way real tools do, then makes one authenticated request to clientsecure.me. Reports which source supplied the credential, whether clientsecure.me accepted it, the round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'no credential' from 'credential rejected' from a 'clientsecure.me-side problem'. Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke. Read-only; never returns the credential itself.
